ideas.pitch: An autonomous ground vehicle equipped with depth cameras and onboard compute to traverse unpredictable obstacle courses.
ideas.title: Autonomous Obstacle-Navigating Vision Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the core judging priority of precision design, fabrication, and intelligent use of sensors for autonomous navigation, mirroring the hardware-focused winners from Quanta and FPT Edu hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A robotic system utilizing lightweight edge AI models on a microcontroller to classify and segregate objects in real time.
ideas.title: Edge AI Dynamic Object Sorter Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates a robust, live physical demo combining embedded coding and sensor integration, a proven winning pattern at robotics-focused hardware hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An advanced differential-drive robot utilizing sensor fusion (IMU, wheel encoders, and IR arrays) for high-precision track mapping and dead reckoning.
ideas.title: Precision Line and Path Mapping Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on the precision level in sensor data fusion and coding efficiency, which directly addresses the core evaluation criteria for IARC at Techkriti.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous exploration rover equipped with real-time wireless telemetry to monitor chassis health and trigger failsafes on sensor anomalies.
ideas.title: Autonomous Telemetry and Safety Lockout Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages real-time edge telemetry and fault detection, echoing winning patterns from complex industrial safety and IoT diagnostics hackathon projects.

ideas.pitch: A modular autonomous robot designed to pick up, transport, and accurately drop off payloads based on visual or analog markers.
ideas.title: Smart Logistics Payload Transport Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles practical task execution under strict timing constraints, impressing judges with a reliable, end-to-end working physical demonstration.
